# godot_select_instance

> Select a Godot instance (id or project_path); later calls are routed to it. Needs GODOT_MCP_MULTI_INSTANCE=true.

| Property | Value |
|------|-----|
| Layer | headless |
| Safety level | safe |
| Needs Godot | yes |
| Needs editor | no |
| Read-only | yes |
| Long-running | no |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|------|------|
| `instance_id` | string |  | Instance ID (from godot_list_instances) |
| `project_path` | string |  | Project path (alternative; instance_id wins) |
